literal_meaning: খাঁদা (দাগযুক্ত বা ফোকা) এবং বোচা (একচোখা বা অন্ধ)
figurative_meaning_en: shameless; nose and ears cut off (utterly disgraced or without shame)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খাঁদা-বোচা হয়ে গেছে, কোনো লজ্জা বোধ করে না।
এই খাঁদা-বোচা লোকের কথা কেউ শোনে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become shameless, feeling no embarrassment at all.
No one listens to this brazen-faced person.
history: Refers to ancient punishments in Bengali society where cutting off nose and ears was a mark of public disgrace for adultery or moral offenses, symbolizing loss of honor.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of physical deformity as metaphor for moral shamelessness, common in rural folklore.
